name: Sky Pirates v1.1 Beta
author: Fatal_Justice
description:
Sky Pirates is a fun, fast-paced, action game. In this game, your objective is to rob banks while avoiding the meteors coming at you.                      
Controls:                                                                                                                  WASD or arrow keys to move the ship.                                                                 Objective:                                                                                                                Fly over banks to rob them while avoiding the various meteors coming at you.
